problem: The LPWAN data-rate range is given as '0.3 to 50 kbit/s'. The 0.3 kbit/s floor is a LoRa figure and the 50 kbit/s ceiling sits below the NB-IoT peak (about 100 kbit/s in downlink multi-tone), so a student may wrongly conclude that NB-IoT cannot exceed 50 kbit/s.
fix: Say the range is roughly 0.1 to 100 kbit/s across LPWAN families, with LoRa at about 0.3 to 37.5 kbit/s and NB-IoT reaching about 100 kbit/s.
